content.caption:
Operation Midnight Snack is officially in motion.
The heavy ceramic jar is finally within reach.
Wait, why does the jar feel lighter than my stomach?
content.scene: A wide-eyed 阿橘, an orange short-haired tabby with amber eyes, balances precariously on a wooden kitchen stool. He is stretching his cream-colored paws toward a tall ceramic jar on a high counter, his tail twitching in intense concentration. The hand-painted illustration captures the soft evening glow of a single lamp, highlighting his determined, slightly chubby expression.
